q19_inspection.assessment: Q19 records 4/5 while crediting reconstructable textual entities, activities and laboratory agents, then withholds 5 because the graph is not explicitly expressed and collections lack was_generated_by. Its broader statement that acquisition-to-archive mapping is unavailable except through filenames overlooks file_collections.description: the IF archives explicitly name assay, cell line, treatment, lab and institution, and SEC-MS/AP-MS descriptions identify their assays and source material. These observations support a representation/field-placement flag under the frozen text-or-graph rule. The input does not necessarily provide all processing-run or raw-accession detail, so complete lineage and a replacement 5 are not certified. The additional non-monotonic-version objection overlooks the explicit separate-deposit/internal-version scope in version_access.version_details; that scoring qualification is separately recorded under issue 1355. Preserve and qualify the original Q19 and containing total.

q19.name: Data Integrity, Provenance Graph, and Quality
q19.description: Presence of version access, errata, update plans, source derivation, parent dataset linkages, missing data documentation, data split indicators, and provenance graph representation.
q19.score_label: Well beyond version history, with a declared provenance graph, short of an explicit graph in the record
q19.evidence: was_derived_from: 'Multimodal experimental interrogation of the MDA-MB-468 breast cancer cell line and the KOLF2.1J induced pluripotent stem cell line and their differentiated derivatives, by AP-MS, SEC-MS, CRISPRi Perturb-seq, and immunofluorescence confocal microscopy.' Provenance packaging declared twice: description states 'CM4AI output data are packaged with provenance graphs and rich metadata as AI-ready datasets in RO-Crate format using the FAIRSCAPE framework', and cm4ai_release_metadata.zip is described as 'comprising RO-Crate metadata and provenance graphs', with conforms_to 'RO-Crate' and conforms_to_standard [RO_CRATE]; distribution_formats notes that earlier releases 'exposed RO-Crate metadata as individual ro-crate-metadata.json files and HTML provenance graph renderings'; notes records FAIRSCAPE ARK persistent identifiers. raw_data_sources: four entries with source_type and destination repositories. version_access and updates as cited in Q13. related_datasets supplies release lineage by DOI. Per-file MD5 checksums on all ten archives. Absent: errata, parent_datasets, missing_data_documentation, splits / is_data_split.
q19.quality_note: Clearly exceeds the 3 band, which is version history alone: a provenance-graph artifact is declared and shipped as a release component, and the textual lineage supplies the three PROV roles in reconstructable form — entities (checksummed, DOI-addressed file collections), activities (four acquisition_methods and five preprocessing_strategies) and agents (named labs in data_collectors, 38 ORCID-identified creators, four maintainers). Integrity is independently supported by MD5 checksums.
q19.semantic_analysis: Held to 4 because the graph is asserted rather than expressed here. The record never wires specific activities to specific outputs — no collection carries a was_generated_by, and a reader cannot tell from this datasheet which acquisition produced which of the ten archives, even though the filenames imply it. Three quality slots are also empty: missing_data_documentation is absent although known_limitations concedes incompletely overlapping protein sets across modalities, and no data-split indicators are given for a dataset explicitly intended for model training. Version-history provenance is itself degraded by the non-monotonic version sequence flagged at Q13.
